leaf.text:
If one of the leaf 2 output descriptors is "0xff", then leaf 2 does not report any cache data and this leaf 0x4 should be used for querying cache parameters.
AMD CPUs support deterministic cache parameters enumeration through cpuid leaf 0x8000001d instead (if available.)

subleaf.desc: Deterministic cache parameters for cache #N, N = subleaf index
subleaf.text:
Enumerate the subleaves, starting from subleaf 0, until @cache_type is Null.
Note that a subleaf index is only an ID for the cache object currently enumerated: it is orthogonal to @cache_level. For example, due to the i/d cache split, L1 cache is typically described by 2 subleaves.
Cache size = (@cache_nways + 1) * (@cache_npartitions + 1) * (@cache_linesize + 1) * (@cache_nsets + 1)

bit14.desc: Number logical CPUs sharing this cache

bit26.desc: Number of cores in the physical package

bit0.desc: WBINVD/INVD not guaranteed for Remote Lower-Level caches

bit1.desc: Cache is inclusive of Lower-Level caches
